scope: Local bounded worker lifecycle event stream

criteria.description: The default local API composition constructs IngestionApplicationService with its own single-process executor, so the existing worker event stream is not observable through the real root application boundary
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes implementation preparedness only; root application behavior remains unverified by this record

criteria.description: The correction is local-only and reversible: the root API owns one bounded telemetry sink, receives only redacted lifecycle metadata with opaque job/request/correlation references, and never forwards scope, source, payload or exception text
criteria.limitations: No exporter, collector, distributed aggregation, alert delivery, production deployment or external service effect is authorized

criteria.description: The real root upload path and direct application-service seam can be covered with deterministic tests for lifecycle visibility, bounded immutable snapshots, reentrant sink safety and sink-failure isolation before a fresh independent review
criteria.limitations: The implementation regression and fresh I1 review remain required after the source change

authority.scope: Local bounded worker lifecycle event stream
authority.decision: Authorize reversible hermetic API/service wiring and review only; no external effect or high-risk acceptance
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before exporter, collector, distributed storage, public event contract, deployment or expanded identity/data scope

next_action: Wire the default root ingestion service to the application-owned bounded telemetry sink and verify the actual upload lifecycle
revalidation_triggers: Root factory or ingestion executor ownership changes
New event fields could contain tenant, source, content, credentials or unbounded cardinality
